'''Kishh'daar''' was a continent of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bakura/Legends|Bakura]]. After the world was colonized by [[Human/Legends|Humans]] from the [[Bakur Mining Corporation]], Kishh'daar was set aside for settlement by Bakura's native [[Kurtzen]] [[Species/Legends|species]] for such [[Time/Legends|time]] as their population grew large enough to warrant it.
